tool_input.content:
# Contributing

```bash
make build
```

```bash
make check
```

`make check` runs the full quality gate: `shellcheck`, `go vet`, `staticcheck`,
`golangci-lint`, `govulncheck`, `markdownlint`, and `go test -race`. Every
commit must pass it before it lands — see `make help` for the individual
targets it composes, and `make lint-strict` / `make vulncheck` / `make docs`
/ `make test` to run any one of them alone.

```bash
make dist
```

Cross-compiles `beadle-email` for darwin/linux, arm64/amd64, into `dist/`.
